task: Open Google Chrome. Navigate to https://httpbin.org/image/png in the first tab. This URL serves a PNG image directly. Save the image to the default Downloads folder as 'httpbin_image.png'. After saving, open a new tab and navigate to https://httpbin.org/robots.txt. Verify the robots.txt page loads and displays text content. Both tabs should remain open when done.
task_grounding: Open Google Chrome. Navigate to https://httpbin.org/image/png in the first tab. This URL serves a PNG image directly. Right-click on the page and select 'Save image as...' (or use Ctrl+S) to save the image to the default Downloads folder as 'httpbin_image.png'. After saving, open a new tab and navigate to https://httpbin.org/robots.txt. Verify the robots.txt page loads and displays text content. Both tabs should remain open when done.
